summary: An older-template DJR page for Turnip, a rugged Bookman-and-Cheltenham-flavoured text face, dressed as a 19th-century American book on grainy cream paper with rust-red ornaments. Almost every specimen is a static SVG drawing rather than live text: a Mark Twain paragraph that climbs through the weights, a first-person profile, and a long feature tour (weights, alternates, short f, figures, small caps and the florets, borders, swelled rules and folio curls that ship with the font) before the standard DJR cart with distributor links.

instances.look: On grainy cream paper, 'TURNIP' in widely spaced small caps inside a rust-red rectangular border of square floret blocks with corner pieces, and 'TRY   BUY' in small red caps beneath; a swelled-rule ornament divider follows
instances.feel: A modest title page from a county printer
instances.ux: Try submits a form that adds the Testing licence to the cart; Buy jumps to #buy
instances.learn: Frame the name with the font's own border ornaments (sides plus corner blocks): the hero shows a feature the buyer will find in the glyph set

reconstruction.typography: Name ~32px Turnip small caps, letter-spacing ~0.15em, near-black; CTAs ~15px Turnip small caps red, ~40px apart
reconstruction.assets: turnip_title.svg (name and border drawn as one SVG), turnip_dash.svg divider, paper-grain background

instances.look: One big paragraph from Twain's 'Jumping Frog' in near-black, whose lines step heavier every two lines while alternating roman and italic: Light small-caps opening 'WELL, THISH-YER SMILEY', Light Italic, Book, Book Italic, Regular, Italic, Medium … down to Black Italic at the end; a tiny italic credit line below

instances.ux: static (an SVG image, not live text)
instances.learn: Run one continuous text through every style in weight order, pairing each roman with its italic: the family overview reads as a passage instead of a list, and the jump between steps is visible line to line

instances.look: 'PROFILE' between two red floret glyphs, then nine short paragraphs in Turnip at book size: 'When you say a typeface is horsey, it is rarely a compliment.' through Lowell storefront signs, Lawson's Anatomy of a Typeface, the 1930 Pynson Printers Tom Sawyer in Monotype Bookman, Cheltenham, and the Reading Edge screen styles
instances.ux: One red link to the Reading Edge series
instances.learn: Open the essay with a self-deprecating hook ('horsey is rarely a compliment') and then argue the virtue: candour makes a quirky design persuasive

reconstruction.content: Designer's first-person origin story and design intent ('dense, punchy paragraphs', 'round, doughy outer forms and crisp, angular inner counters')

instances.look: 'FEATURES': rust-red samples on cream, each followed by a paragraph with a bold run-in head. Pairs: Regular vs Book ('But still he was lucky, uncommonly lucky…'), default vs ball-terminal s ('Impressive earnestness, also sincerity'), default italic vs single-storey g, non-cursive k, non-cursive p and swash k ('Frogs skipping to kingpins of Poughkeepsie'), each labelled in tiny italics; then single samples for short f, text figures, small caps, and under 'AND OTHER SKETCHES' the ornaments: a 'MARK TWAIN' lockup with florets, a 'Celebrated Jumping Frog' title in a block border, swelled rules and '256' folio curls
instances.feel: A thorough, chatty tour by the designer
instances.learn: Give every feature the same unit (sample in the accent colour, tiny label, run-in-headed paragraph) and write the sample phrase so it is crowded with the glyphs that change

reconstruction.layout: Block 1440×3755; samples ~980px wide centred (x≈230–1210); paragraphs indented to ~860px (x≈290–1150); ~80px between features; labels ~6px under each sample line

reconstruction.content: Twain-flavoured phrases and invented ones ('Frogs skipping to kingpins of Poughkeepsie', 'He made a $40 bet on May 16, 1849…', 'Published in The Saturday Press'); real technical notes: borders built from side and corner blocks on the em square, dash extender lengthens rules by one em, folio curls nod to the Pynson Printers Tom Sawyer
reconstruction.assets: One SVG per sample (turnip_weights_regular.svg, turnip_salt_italic_g.svg, turnip_onum.svg, turnip_smcp.svg, turnip_ornm_borders.svg …)
reconstruction.html: img.fill[alt=feature] followed by p > span.subhead (run-in head) + text
